LIC AAO Mains Result 2026 Out @licindia.in

The Life Insurance Corporation of India has announced the result for the AAO (Generalist) and others posts for 32nd Batch Mains Examination which was conducted on 08th November 2025. Candidates who have qualified in Phase II are now shortlisted for the LIC AAO Interview round. The recruitment is being conducted for a total of 841 AAO vacancies. Applicants can check and download the LIC AAO Mains Result 2026 PDF from the below article.

LIC AAO Result 2026: Overview

The Life Insurance Corporation of India has announced the LIC AAO Result 2026 for candidates who appeared in the Phase II exam. This result confirms the list of candidates shortlisted for the interview round under the AAO (Generalist) recruitment.

LIC AAO Mains Result 2026 Download PDF

The LIC AAO Mains Result 2026 PDF is available for all the posts. This PDF contains the names and roll numbers of candidates shortlisted for the interview stage. Candidates can open the result PDF and search their roll number as per the post they applied for. There are separate PDFs provided for AAO Specialist disciplines, AAO generalist posts, and others. Candidates can download the result PDF using the link given below once it is officially released on the LIC website.

How to Check LIC AAO Phase 2 Result 2026?

The LIC AAO Phase 2 Result 2026 is released in PDF format on the official LIC website. Candidates can follow the simple steps below to check and download their result.

  1. Visit the official website of LIC at www.licindia.in.
  2. Click on the Careers or Recruitment section on the homepage.
  3. Open the link named LIC AAO Mains Result 2026.
  4. The result PDF will appear on the screen with qualified roll numbers.
  5. Use Ctrl + F and enter your roll number or name to search quickly.
  6. If your details are listed, you have qualified for the Interview round.
  7. And then you have to download it and save the result PDF for future reference.

What After LIC AAO Phase 2 Result 2026?

Now, after the LIC AAO Phase 2 Result 2026 is out, candidates who will qualify will move to the Interview stage of the selection process. LIC will now release the interview schedule and call letters on its official website. Shortlisted candidates has to carry all required documents for verification during the interview. The interview round is going to test candidate’s subject knowledge, confidence, and communication skills.  The final selection is going to be based on marks scored in the Mains exam and the Interview.

LIC AAO Mains Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is LIC AAO Mains Result 2026 released?

Ans. Yes, The LIC AAO Phase 2 Result 2026 is officially declared on 25th February 2026 for Generalist, Specialist and other posts.

Q2. How can I download the LIC AAO Mains Result 2026 PDF?

Ans. You can download LIC AAO Mains Result PDF by visiting www.licindia.in.

Q3. What details are mentioned in the LIC AAO Phase 2 Result PDF?

Ans. The result PDF includes the roll numbers and names of shortlisted candidates who have qualified for the LIC AAO Interview round.

Q4. What is the next stage after LIC AAO Mains Result 2026?

Ans. After qualifying the mains exam, you will be called for the LIC AAO Interview. It is the final stage of the selection process.

Q5. How many vacancies are being filled through LIC AAO Recruitment 2026?

Ans. The LIC AAO recruitment is going to fill a total of 841 Assistant Administrative Officer vacancies across Generalist, Specialist and other posts.
